{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Norat''' were a group ruled by the [[Norat Sovereignty]].<ref name="NS">{{CSWECite|II|389|Norat Sovereignty}}.</ref> [[Crandor Ijjix]] was a Norat.<ref name="CI">{{CSWECite|II|81|Crandor Ijjix}}.</ref> The Norat were destroyed by the [[Yevetha]].<ref name="NS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Norat feature in the novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]''. The ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' also mention the group. None of these sources reveals whether the Norat are a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or some other type of group.
